issue_summary: README contradicts the Digger/Miner split and the hidden branch mine
evidence: README.md (How it works; Known limits) still says the shovel, axe, and hoe roles have no jobs, says the Digger has no jobs, and still tells the player to order a branch mine. crew_bp/scripts/catalog.js gives quarry to Digger only and sets branch_mine hidden. PLAYER_GUIDE.md (Build a worker) and CHANGELOG.md Unreleased describe that split.
suggested_fix: Leave the pack as-is. A worker pull request Brian asks for can update README. The curator only records the drift.

issue_summary: BP manifest description was not updated when the version became 0.4.0
evidence: crew_bp/manifest.json header.description still says v0.2 quarry and branch mining. header.version, the module versions, the RP dependency, crew_rp/manifest.json, and crew_bp/scripts/util.js VERSION are all 0.4.0. branch_mine is hidden, so the sentence is stale as a feature list too.
suggested_fix: Do not bump the version to refresh a sentence. A fix(pack): pull request can edit the description only, when Brian wants that pack text updated.

issue_summary: PLAN.md still describes a 27-slot inventory and a player-facing Fast pace
evidence: docs/PLAN.md architecture blurb says worker.json has a 27-slot inventory, and Open settings still says Fast pace (5x) is available to everyone. crew_bp/entities/worker.json sets inventory_size to 36. CLAUDE.md decision 30 says Fast pace was removed. crew_bp/scripts/catalog.js has no pace param.
suggested_fix: Prefer worker.json and decision 30. knowledge/domain/server-rules.md already points at the drift. Do not edit PLAN.md from a knowledge pull request unless Brian asks for that doc pass.

issue_summary: BP en_US.lang is missing the Give torches interact string the entity references
evidence: crew_bp/texts/en_US.lang has no action.interact.crew_give_torches line. crew_rp/texts/en_US.lang has it. crew_bp/entities/worker.json uses that key as interact_text. The other lang lines match.
suggested_fix: A fix(pack): pull request can add the same line to the BP lang file. Whether the client reads the RP string only is an open question in knowledge/domain/pack-conventions.md.

issue_summary: Charter folder names do not match crew_bp and crew_rp
evidence: docs/grok/POC-KNOWLEDGE-FACTORY-v5.md scaffold says behavior_packs/ and resource_packs/. This repo's source folders are crew_bp/ and crew_rp/. README.md Install on Bedrock Dedicated Server copies those folders into a server's behavior_packs and resource_packs directories.
suggested_fix: AGENTS.md and knowledge/domain/pack-conventions.md tell agents to use crew_bp and crew_rp. Do not rename the packs to match the charter.

issue_summary: release.mjs does not update the version examples in README.md
evidence: README.md hard-codes pack version [0, 4, 0] and the log line v0.4.0. Those match the manifests today. tools/release.mjs bumps the manifests, util.js, and the changelog, then prints a reminder. It never rewrites README.md.
suggested_fix: When the next release is cut, include a README version-example update in that release, or teach release.mjs to do it. Not a knowledge-file edit.

issue_summary: Spec status words are listed but not defined for when a pull request may open, and worker-agent.md blocks a pull request unless the status is ready.
evidence: specs/_TEMPLATE.md lists draft, ready, building, in review, and shipped, and only says ready means Brian answered the open questions. specs/settlement-layer.md was Status building on main and in review on feat/settlement-layer before Brian set it to ready on 2026-11-27. knowledge/agents/worker-agent.md operating rule 3 names only ready. knowledge/skills/scripting-api.md repeats that and does not define the other words.
suggested_fix: Document what each status word allows, including whether a pull request may open while the spec says building or in review, in knowledge/skills. That is a curator change, not a pack edit.

issue_summary: Settlement world dynamic properties and settlement.js are missing from the pack-conventions and scripting-api tables.
evidence: crew_bp/scripts/settlement.js saves crew:settlements, crew:bells, crew:seen, crew:queue, crew:cap, and crew:stock:<spot>. knowledge/domain/pack-conventions.md lists only crew:name, crew:ownerId, crew:home, crew:job, crew:places, crew:workers, and crew:toolPref. knowledge/skills/scripting-api.md does not name settlement.js.
suggested_fix: When a curator updates knowledge, add those keys and settlement.js to the tables. Do not rename the crew: keys.

issue_summary: README does not mention settlements after the settlement release
evidence: README.md has no settlement or bell text. CHANGELOG.md Unreleased and crew_bp/scripts/guide_pages.js (Your settlement) describe founding at a placed bell. Commit 6ef219c added crew_bp/scripts/settlement.js.
suggested_fix: A worker pull request can add a settlement section to README. The curator does not edit README.

issue_summary: The scripting skill does not name plots.js or the forest and field jobs.
evidence: knowledge/skills/scripting-api.md module table has no plots.js. crew_bp/scripts/plots.js owns the forest and field passes. crew_bp/scripts/catalog.js adds forest (Woodcutter) and field (Farmer).
suggested_fix: When a curator updates knowledge/skills, add plots.js to the module table and name the forest and field jobs next to quarry.

issue_summary: PLAN.md still says the Farmer cooks, and Brian said on 2026-11-27 that the Farmer does not cook.
evidence: docs/PLAN.md Later section says Farmer (fields, cooks food for the crew). specs/woodcutter-farmer.md decision Q7 says no cooking. The pack does not cook.
suggested_fix: A docs pass Brian asks for can drop cooking from that PLAN.md line. Do not edit PLAN.md from this pack pull request.

issue_summary: spec-status.md says ready means every open question is answered, while the Woodcutter and Farmer spec is ready and still lists questions the builder must not guess.
evidence: knowledge/skills/spec-status.md says ready means Brian answered every open question. specs/woodcutter-farmer.md is status ready and its Open questions cover water placement and crops that grow a neighbor block. The 2026-11-27 instruction set the status to ready and said not to guess those parts.
suggested_fix: Record whether a ready spec may list questions a builder must build around, or move those two items to Out of scope so ready and spec-status.md agree.
